# Development test fixtures

These small ZIP/Office/PDF files are synthetic examples or publicly licensed reference samples used by the import and command tests. Passwords in this directory are test data, not user credentials. Do not place case evidence, personal documents, recovered passwords, or runtime logs here.

The original test password `ForenHC2026!` is retained so the existing encrypted fixtures remain reproducible. Public Office reference samples come from msoffcrypto-tool (MIT); see THIRD_PARTY.md. The Hashcat status fixture was captured from a deliberately absent synthetic MD5 target.
